_README: The field map. Hand-checked from selectors_recorded.json on 2026-08-10.
WHY THESE USE name= AND NOT id=:
Bottomline is built on ExtJS, which invents ids like 'textfield-1752-inputEl'
fresh on every page load. Those ids are useless as permanent addresses. The
name attributes (Image_Index_Ref etc.) are hand-authored on Bottomline's side
and are stable. Never replace these with the # ids from the raw capture.
SCOPE: the image indexing screen ONLY. The script fills these boxes and stops
before 'Convert to Invoice'. It never presses Convert, Save, or Delete.
_autocomplete_note: These are NOT plain text boxes. Typing into them and moving on does not
set a value. You must type, wait for the dropdown, then click the match --
that is what stores the underlying code. After selecting vendor or property,
their code auto-loads on screen; the script should confirm that happened
before treating the field as done.
_dropdown_item_note: OBSERVED, not inferred. Updated 2026-08-14 -- the ':visible' part is the
important half and was added after it caused a live failure.
WHY ':visible' IS NOT OPTIONAL:
ExtJS does not destroy a dropdown when it closes. It leaves the whole
list sitting in the page, hidden. So a bare '.x-boundlist-item' matches
items belonging to EVERY combo box on the screen -- the one that is open
and all the closed ones too.
The 2026-08-14 16:31 run proved it. While reading the PROPERTY dropdown,
the script resolved to this leftover from the Integration Package box:
<li data-boundview="customcombo-1736-picker"
class="x-boundlist-item x-boundlist-selected">YARDI
and spent 30 seconds trying to click something invisible.
Two consequences, and the second is the dangerous one:
1. clicks time out on hidden leftovers;
2. the MATCH COUNT is wrong. The Property dropdown had no real match,
but the stale YARDI item made the count 1, which the integration
package check reads as 'confirmed'. The only reason a wrong package
was not recorded is that clicking an invisible item happens to fail.
The earlier note here argued the selector had to be right because the
script 'could not have counted matches otherwise'. That reasoning was
wrong: it was counting, just counting the wrong things as well.
If the script ever reports 'no dropdown appeared' on a vendor you know
exists, check the SPELLING in the spreadsheet first. That was the cause
the one time it happened (Steps Appliance Repair LLC, 2026-08-10).
_verify_note: image_name is READ, never typed into. Before filling anything, the script
reads this box and checks it matches the Image Name column in the
spreadsheet row. If they differ, it stops. This is what makes it impossible
to record one vendor's invoice against another's document.
_queue_note: The 'Images to be Indexed' screen. All of these were observed in the
index_selected uses Bottomline's OWN class, never a position on the
toolbar. The delete icon sits on that same toolbar and acts on whatever
rows are ticked. A loose selector here could bin a client's invoice.
menu_item carries ':visible' for the same reason as dropdown_item_selector
above -- an ExtJS menu stays in the page while hidden. Without it the
script found the 'Images to be Indexed' item, spent 30 seconds trying to
click something invisible, and then threw. With it, a menu that is not
open simply counts as absent and the script goes straight to the queue's
menu_opener / menu_opener_text: the 'Images to be Indexed' item lives
INSIDE a top-level toolbar button, 'Image Management', and is not in the
page at all until that button is opened. Without opening it first the item
count is 0 -- exactly the 2026-08-18 failure ('Could not find the Images
to be Indexed menu item'). The script now HOVERS, then clicks only if
needed, on 'Image Management' to reveal the menu before clicking the item.
Selected by visible text because the ExtJS id (hoverButton-1054-...) is
regenerated every load. Observed on screen 2026-08-18.
_header_note: Reads 'Image Index - <image name>' on the indexing screen. This is how the
script proves the indexing screen actually opened before it touches
anything -- see the delete-icon warning above.
top-page-header-text is Bottomline's own class. The other two classes on
generic ExtJS and match other screens' headings too. Do not use them.

out_of_scope._why: Everything below appears only AFTER 'Convert to Invoice', which the script never presses.

dropped.gl_account: Bottomline has no GL account field on this screen. Confirmed 2026-08-10.
dropped.document_type: input[name="Image_Doctype_Id"] - exists, arrives pre-filled ('General ...'), operators rarely change it. Confirmed on screen 2026-08-13. Out of scope for V1.
